hypothesis: Paired Keep/Drop audio interventions provide a label-free necessity-sufficiency signal that can conservatively select among complementary SpotSound checkpoints.

verifier.score: first-token logit(Yes)-logit(No) under the official detection prompt
verifier.audio_intervention: timeline-preserving zero mask with 10 ms squared-sine boundary fades

router.model: relative ridge regression with official fallback
router.threshold_selection: maximize calibration mIoU subject to mean downside <= 0.25 point; ties prefer the larger threshold

development_gate.primary_manifest: ordinary event queries reconstructed from RelTwin held-out test mixtures
development_gate.relation_query_role: mechanism diagnostic only; relation-query router results cannot unlock public evaluation

public_guardrail: If the pilot passes, write and lock a separate confirmatory public protocol before extracting any SpotSound-Bench NOVA features. SpotSound labels must not be used for fitting, thresholding, checkpoint selection, or feature normalization.
